issue.title: The “Queen of Contemporary Horror” is back!

caption: The best new books this week! Rachel Harrison delivers a career-best horror, and an utterly delightful Japanese bestseller has been making waves.
altText: Cover slide showing the Kiss Slay Replay book cover, a tiered white wedding cake with a bloodied knife. Text reads: Book Pix, this week's picks. Exciting new book releases. Rachel Harrison delivers a career-best horror. Plus, an utterly delightful Japanese bestseller has been making waves. By Pix, 4 min read.
Pull quote: Horror fans will have a blast with this fun, bloody romp. Attribution reads: Publishers Weekly, on Kiss Slay Replay.
Pix editors recommend Kiss Slay Replay by Rachel Harrison, shown with its cover. Worth reading because it turns wedding-day horror into a Groundhog Day-esque time loop.

Pix editors recommend How Can My Manager Be So Stupid? by Kazumasa Hayami, shown with its cover. Worth reading for its witty, bookish take on career burnout and the all-too-relatable nightmare of a terrible boss.
Outro slide with a single-line drawing of an open book. Text reads: More in Book Pix, every Tuesday, Thursday, and Sunday. Button reads: Link in bio.
